verdict.rationale: Factory documents a public API for creating and driving Droid sessions (factory-docs-13) plus CLI/exec automation paths (droid exec, CI/CD) that give programmatic control, but there's no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s), suggesting the API reference is thinner or less formally specified than a full REST API story would require. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/swagger schema, broader API endpoint coverage beyond sessions, independent third-party confirmation of API usage.
